messages:
Eve Chen: heads-up: planning a low-risk blue->green shift for router-edge from v2.2.9 -> v2.3.0 during 00:30 UTC change window. Main changes: connection pooling tweaks + cert auto-rotate.
Ravi Menon: noted. what's the ramp profile?
Eve Chen: 2% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 8m holds. abort if p95 > 2x baseline or total 5xxs > 2% over 5m.
Lena Morales: Session affinity is IP-hash. We'll ensure config-store retains pin for 30m after full shift to avoid churn.
Tom G.: I'll pre-pull kernels and warm model caches on green. Also will run cert reload test.
deploy-bot: Preflight: configs validated, green nodes=3 (ready), certs expire in 90d, auto-rotate enabled.
Eve Chen: Release note draft for ops/support: "router-edge: v2.2.9->v2.3.0, pool tuning, cert auto-rotate. Note: may see transient 5xxs during cert reload." Publish when shift starts.
Ravi Menon: Adding a quick smoke check to the monitor job: 
```
curl -sS -X POST https://router-edge.internal/health -d '{"probe":"ok"}' | jq .ok
```
Tom G.: smoke green from green pool. p50 10ms, p95 38ms.
Eve Chen: Starting 2% siphon in 90s. Tom please watch cert reload logs, Lena watch affinity.
deploy-bot: Step 1: shifted 2% traffic to green (v2.3.0). snapshot=run-1725005555-1.
Ravi Menon: p95 39ms (baseline 36), errors 0.2%.
Lena Morales: affinity stable. new sessions on green=34.
Tom G.: cert reload test shows one instance logged a brief TLS handshake failure during rotation, auto-retry worked.
Eve Chen: Hold. If handshake failures persist > 2m we pin back and roll.
deploy-bot: watch: tls-handshake-failures=1 (transient), 5xx=0.3%.
Ravi Menon: okay to move to 20% in 6m if steady.
Tom G.: moving to 20% now. increasing slowstart window on LB.
deploy-bot: Step 2: shifted 20% traffic to green.
Ravi Menon: small bump in p95 to 58ms then settling. 5xxs up to 0.9% briefly.
Lena Morales: affinity sticky ratio 97.4% good.
Eve Chen: good. hold 8m. Reminder: if external partners see higher errors, we'll pin to blue and open rollback.
Tom G.: watching memcache and upstream timeouts. pre-warmed caches at 94% hit.
deploy-bot: metric snapshot stored run-1725005555-2.
Ravi Menon: advancing to 50% now.
deploy-bot: Step 3: shifted 50% traffic to green.
Ravi Menon: noticing sporadic 503s on one node (node-1) correlated with cert reload spiking CPU ~90%.
Eve Chen: pause ramp. Tom, can you drain and restart node-1? Lena, check session handoff counts.
Tom G.: draining node-1, restarted nginx, healthchecks passed. restarted with same cert, CPU back to 45%.
deploy-bot: node-1 restart logged run-1725005555-node1-restart.
Ravi Menon: 503s returned to baseline. error rate 1.2% currently. p95 60ms.
Lena Morales: session handoff counted ~210 sessions moved gracefully. affinity still healthy.
Eve Chen: since recovery < abort thresholds, proceed but slow: next step to 75% with 12m watch. Also we'll set a temporary pin to keep v2.3.0 for 1h after completion.
Tom G.: increasing slow-start further and reducing max concurrent connections to ease pressure.
deploy-bot: Step 4: shifted 75% traffic to green.
Ravi Menon: metrics steady. No new TLS or 5xx spikes.
Eve Chen: final hold 12m then full. Ops note published: link=https://internal.ops/notes/1725005555.
Tom G.: proceeding to 100%.
deploy-bot: Step 5: shifted 100% traffic to green. config-store pinned router-edge=v2.3.0.
Ravi Menon: p95 57ms, errors 1.0% stable, cpu-green avg 52%.
Lena Morales: session affinity 98.9% after pin.
Eve Chen: Closing tasks: created follow-up ticket to add pre-shift cert-reload simulation to runbook. Marking memcache/cert rotation as notes for postmortem (minor). Leaving monitoring for 90m. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
